firstVideo.title: Your first video
firstVideo.listLabel: Three steps to your first video
firstVideo.addTitle: {material, select, code {Add your code} any {Add what you start from} other {Add your clips}}
firstVideo.addBody: {material, select, code {Connect the repository, or upload the code as a zip.} idea {Film the five clips on your shot list, then drop them in.} any {Clips you already shot, or the source code of an app you built.} other {Drop in what you already shot. Several different shots make a real edit.}}
firstVideo.briefBody: One or two sentences: who the video is for and what it should show.
firstVideo.briefExample: {persona, select, creator {For example: “The best moments of this trip, for my followers.”} business {For example: “Our new autumn menu, for people who live nearby.”} educator {For example: “The one idea of this lesson, for new students.”} nonprofit {For example: “What last weekend's clean-up achieved, for our supporters.”} software {For example: “What is new in this release, for people who already use the app.”} agency {For example: “A first cut of the client's launch, for their social channels.”} other {For example: “What happened and why it matters, for people who were not there.”}}
firstVideo.runBody: You get a first cut to react to. Minutes for a small job, sometimes half an hour for a big one. You can leave the page while it works.
firstVideo.ctaRun: Say what it is for and press Run
